_note: Models a run can use, by name, in the order the page shows them. label: the name on the page. url: an OpenAI-compatible API base. template_kwargs: chat-template variables sent with every request (the thinking switch). A hosted API also needs api_key_env (the environment variable holding its key) and model (its own model id). local: a model served from runtime/ (python pa-to-pa.pyw serve), which listens on url's port: its file, where python pa-to-pa.pyw fetch downloads it from (pinned to one revision) and its size, the context and slots it's served with, and llama-server's placement arguments. slot: a model reserved for later, shown on the page but not usable yet; the text says what's missing.

local._placement: every layer on the GPU: llama.cpp's own fitter keeps ~1 GB spare and would leave some in RAM, at a quarter of the speed. ~7.5 GB of an 8 GB GPU.

claude-api.label: Claude (API)
claude-api.slot: Not set up yet: needs an Anthropic API key (a Claude Max subscription doesn't include API access) and a client for Anthropic's Messages API, ideally its official SDK.

chatgpt-api.label: ChatGPT (API)
chatgpt-api.slot: Not set up yet: needs an OpenAI API key (a ChatGPT or Codex subscription doesn't include API access) and the model id to use.
